Alternative_Claims: Do vaccines cause autism? | Vaccines make children autistic
Explanation: Large studies have not found that vaccines cause autism. Vaccines protect people from serious diseases.

Claim: Washing hands with soap helps prevent infections
Alternative_Claims: Handwashing with soap prevents germs | Soap and water stop the spread of germs
Explanation: Washing hands with soap and water removes germs and helps stop infections from spreading.
Source_Name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

Alternative_Claims: Bleach cures coronavirus | Drink disinfectant to kill COVID
Explanation: Bleach and other disinfectants are poisonous if swallowed. They do not cure COVID-19 and can cause severe harm.

Claim: Drinking water helps your body stay healthy
Alternative_Claims: You should drink water to stay healthy | Water is important for the body
Explanation: Water helps the body stay hydrated and supports normal body functions. People should drink safe water every day.

Claim: Antibiotics can kill viruses like the common cold
Alternative_Claims: Antibiotics cure a cold | Antibiotics work on viruses
Explanation: Antibiotics fight bacteria, not viruses. Colds are usually caused by viruses, so antibiotics do not cure them.

Claim: Wearing a helmet while riding a bicycle helps protect your head
Alternative_Claims: Bike helmets protect your head | You should wear a helmet on a bicycle
Explanation: A well-fitted helmet reduces the chance of a serious head injury if you fall while cycling.
